finalText:
I didn't remove it: that sticky is locked.

The red pricing sticky is "PRICING: keep the student tier — decided with Tereza" (`stk-299`, in the Pricing section, by Marek). Someone locked it, and I can't change or remove anything a person has locked. To delete it, select it on the board, unlock it with ⇧⌘L, then delete it or ask me again.

The board has four other stickies about a student tier, all "want a free tier for students" notes. None of them is red or a pricing decision, so I left them alone. I made no changes to the board, so there's nothing to screenshot.
